game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool, a blue oasis pool: the caravan guide must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Print Tracer: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what giant scorpions changed.
theme: Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool: a blue oasis pool
core_gameplay_loop: In Oasis Pool, repeat each round: Insert print statements at the right lines to reveal what giant scorpions changed. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the trace_clarity value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about trace_clarity to power up the caravan guide and open the temple door.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 10 (extended tier): Print Tracer
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Print Tracer' (Week 9 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Oasis Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_clarity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Oasis Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 12.
